movement_profile.difficulty: Beginner to advanced, depending on improvisation skill and role flexibility
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in pairs on social dance floors; partners may switch roles and positions fluidly
movement_profile.partnering: Flexible leader-follower roles; partners may be any gender combination and exchange roles during dance

signature_moves.description: Partners switch leader and follower roles during the dance, sometimes mid-tanda.
signature_moves.name: Role Exchange

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Improvisational within traditional tango tempo range
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid enforcing traditional gender roles; respect partner’s chosen role and expression

music_profile.musical_form: Traditional tango forms with instrumental and vocal sections
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Traditional Argentine tango rhythmic patterns supporting improvisation
music_profile.sound_description: The music features the characteristic bandoneón-led melodies with rhythmic pulses and melancholic tones typical of Argentine tango, providing a rich emotional backdrop for improvisational dance.
music_profile.vocal_style: Not specifically described; traditional tango vocals may be used

basic_steps: Assume any partner combination and choose leader or follower role
Establish connection with partner through embrace
Communicate lead and follow through body signals
Practice role exchange during the dance
Improvise steps within traditional tango vocabulary
teaching.formation: Danced in pairs with flexible roles; social dance floor setting
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning both leading and following basics and practicing role exchange
teaching.rhythm: 2/4 or 4/4 meter typical of Argentine tango music
